name: taom_spcultures
description: Custom culture definitions (taom_spcultures.xml). Every basic_troop / elite_basic_troop / militia / NPC-role / party-template attribute is a cross-reference and is checked by the global sweep: NPCCharacter.* refs must resolve to a defined troop/character, PartyTemplate.* refs to a defined party template. Catches the 'culture points at a deleted troop' bug class.
